judgement.reason: Grist can keep documents in S3-compatible storage with PostgreSQL for the home database, so the contained-change outcome stands.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (GRIST_DATA_DIR=/persist/docs (Dockerfile)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: Grist stores each document as a SQLite file under GRIST_DATA_DIR, and none of the shown lines configures S3 or another external store for those documents, so the finding is not shown to be wrong.
